incidents.title: Worker fall from scaffolding
incidents.description: Worker fell from 2nd floor scaffolding. Minor injuries. Hospitalized for observation.

incidents.title: Electrical short circuit
incidents.description: Short circuit in temporary site office wiring. No injuries. Fire extinguished quickly.

incidents.title: Equipment collision
incidents.description: JCB loader grazed boundary wall. No personnel involved. Minor structural damage to wall.

incidents.title: Chemical exposure – cement dust
incidents.description: Three workers reported respiratory irritation due to cement dust without proper masks.

incidents.title: Fire alarm activation
incidents.description: Fire alarm triggered by welding sparks. Building evacuated. False alarm confirmed.

hazards.title: Unsecured rebar ends at 3F
hazards.description: Multiple rebar ends protruding without safety caps. Trip and puncture hazard.

hazards.title: Waterlogged excavation zone
hazards.description: Rainwater accumulated near excavation zone. Slip risk for workers.

hazards.title: Inadequate site lighting at night
hazards.description: Night-shift workers operating without adequate lighting.

hazards.title: Temporary electrical wiring
hazards.description: Exposed wiring running across walkway. Electrocution and trip hazard.

inspections.title: Monthly Site Safety Inspection
inspections.notes: PPE compliance improved. Fire extinguisher locations need review.

inspections.title: Fire Safety Audit
inspections.notes: Exit signage adequate. Need to replace 3 expired extinguishers.

inspections.title: Scaffolding Integrity Check
inspections.notes: Section C scaffolding joints loose. Must be re-secured before work resumes.

inspections.title: Electrical Installation Review
inspections.notes: All temporary wiring properly insulated. Good compliance.
